events.title: SXI Q1 Deep Dive: Portfolio Simplification and Fast-Growth Markets Drive Mixed Market Reaction
events.body: Industrial manufacturer Standex (NYSE:SXI) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 8.1% year on year to $224.6 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.21 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
